body: In production we sometimes see a TypeError crash across the profile rendering path when the upstream API returns a null user record. It is intermittent — only some sessions hit it, depending on which records the API returns. `display_name` in shopcalc/profiles.py assumes the user is always a dict and crashes when it is None. When the user is None it should return "Unknown" instead of crashing. Please investigate the profile module and anything that calls into it before fixing, since multiple call sites render names.
title: Intermittent crash rendering profiles when the API returns a null user
